findings.issue: תִּהְיֶה is qal imperfect 3fs with predicate טְמֵאָה and subject הִוא (she shall be unclean). יָמִים is masculine plural and cannot be that subject. Spanish attaches será to todos días … como días and, after the semicolon, leaves impura ella verbless.
The second flow verb is qal imperfect 3fs (the woman flows); the first is 3ms (the flow flows). The second fluyere has no subject, so it can still be read as flujo.

notes: Other tokens match: woman, both כִּי, blood, many days, not in the time of her niddah, or, upon, all days of the flow of her impurity, like the days of her niddah.
